paragraphs.text: Render AI answers as interactive UI cards in DSH: comparisons, charts, diagrams, tables, calculators
and unit conversions. The model writes a JSON spec — never markup.
**English** | 简体中文
# dsh-intelligent-ui

Generative UI for DSH conversations. The model calls one tool, `ui_render`,
writes a JSON UI Schema

— and the page renders a live, state-bound interactive
interface: forms, KPIs, charts and tables lin

ked by shared state, micro-apps,
maps, streaming growth. The same tool also renders ten fixed card k

inds for
answers that are a single static structure, and a Schema Playground for humans.

The model writes **data, never HTML/JSX/JavaScript**. Specs are plain JSON, so
they survive the sess

ion log, a fork and a resume unchanged. Bindings run in a
hand-written safe expression language (no

`eval`, fixed function table), state
changes flow through an Action Router that reports only effects

that really
happened, and semantic tones resolve to theme tokens so every card works in
light and d

t really
happened, and semantic tones resolve to theme tokens so every card works in
light and dark.
## Two vocabularies
**Fixed cards** — one structure per answer, render instantly, no state:
| `kind` | When to use | Main fields |
| `compare` | three or more things compared on shared criteria | `columns`, `rows[{label, cells[]}]`

|
| `chart` | a series of magnitudes (`bar`), a trend (`line`), parts of one whole (`pie` / `donut`

) | `series[{label, value, tone?, hint?}]`, `variant`, `unit` |
| `stats` | two to six headline figu

res | `stats[{label, value, tone?, hint?}]` |
| `progress` | one ratio to feel at a glance — pass ra

te, quota used | `value`, `max`, `label`, `unit`, `tone` |
| `steps` | three or more ordered steps |

`steps["text" \| {text, detail?}]` |
| `table` | rows and columns of records | `columns`, `rows[][]

` |
| `diagram` | boxes joined by arrows, or any Mermaid family | `nodes[{id, label, detail?, tone?}

]` + `edges[{from, to, label?}]` + `layout`, or raw `mermaid` |
| `calculator` | arithmetic the user

will redo with their own numbers | `mode: split \| tip`, `fields[{label, value, min?, max?}]` |
| `

unit` | a quantity converted between units | `units`, `factors?`, `from`, `to`, `value` |
| `note` |
one thing the reader must not miss | `text`, `tone` |
**Generative UI** — `kind: "app"`, the interactive vocabulary:
| `kind` | When to use | Main fields |
| `app` | an interactive tool, simulator or dashboard the user adjusts and watches update live | `st

ate`, `compute`, `tree` (`{id, type, props, bind, on, children}`), `stream` |
| `playground` | an ed
itable JSON UI Schema with live validation and preview | `source` (JSON text; a broken schema is exp
ema with live validation and preview | `source` (JSON text; a broken schema is expected and shown) |

An `app` is a component tree drawn from a 71-type registry — 77 names with the
chart aliases (text,

layout,
controls, charts, tables, maps, media, feedback, `quiz`/`flashcard`/
`countdown`), wired tog

ether by `bind` expressions over `state` + `compute`
and `on` actions (`set`, `toggle`, `copy`, `ope

n`, `submit`, `call`). One input
change updates every dependent KPI, chart and table at once.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- **Host half** (`index.js`): the tool schema and prompt section live next to
the validator; structu

red `diagram` specs are compiled to Mermaid source on
the Host, so the session log stores exactly th

e diagram that was drawn.
- **Shared engine** (`engine.cjs`, CommonJS on purpose): the Host `import`

s it,
the Client loads `client.engine.js`. Both halves validate and evaluate with
identical code — t

hey cannot drift.
- **Client half** (`client.js`): everything visual. Charts and diagrams go
through

ECharts/Mermaid lazy chunks (`client.echarts.js` / `client.mermaid.js`,
generated, git-ignored); ev
erything else is plain React over theme tokens.

Details: docs/architecture.md ·
docs/schema.md · docs/components.md.
### Following the font size

DSH's theme presenter writes the user's content font size to `document.body` as
`--dsh-content-font-

size` (10–22px) and emits `theme/change` on every change.
Stylesheet rules are `calc(<authored size>

+ var(--iui-fs-delta))`, so a whole
card scales from one write; ECharts and Mermaid get real px num

bers from the
same variable, with a floor so the smallest labels stay readable.

installing, or charts degrade t

o a plain-text summary and apps cannot load the

## What is real vs mock
| Mechanism | Status |
| Rendering of all 71 components (77 names with chart aliases), nesting, `hidden`/`span` | **Real**

|
| State binding (`bind`), `compute` derivation, one-input→many-views re-render | **Real** |
| Acti
ons `set`, `toggle`, `copy` (Clipboard API), `open` (`window.open` + popup-block detection), `submit

` | **Real** — success is toasted only after the effect really happened |
| `dataTable` sorting / se

arch / filter / pagination / selection / CSV export | **Real** (view-local) |
| Streaming protocol m
echanics (sequence numbers, dedupe, out-of-order repair, `stream.error` + `retry()` resume) and Mock

Streaming replay | **Real** |
| External service `call` | **Mocked** — no service ships registered,
so a `call` explicitly reports *"service … is not connected"*, never a fake success. Wiring seam: t

he `services` registry in `useAppRuntime` (docs/architecture.md) |
| Real LLM SSE streaming | **Rese
rved** — `createSseSource` exists as the integration point and rejects with "not connected" until a

backend endpoint is configured |
| `map` | **Schematic** — an equirectangular SVG projection of the
declared places (real math, no tile service). MapLibre/Leaflet were not used: both need network rast
er tiles and a much larger payload inside a chat card; a tile map can replace it behind the same nod

e type |
| `math` | **Formula subset** — `x^2`, `x_i`, `\frac{a}{b}`, `\sqrt{x}`, degrading to plain

text. KaTeX was not used: its renderer needs 20+ woff2 fonts the plugin route cannot serve |
| `mar
kdown` | **Safe subset** — headings, lists, quotes, fenced code, inline bold/italic/code/links, rend

ered as React elements; never HTML |
| `fileUpload` | **Metadata only** — the action receives file n
ames and sizes; nothing is transferred (no upload backend) |

Per-component behaviour and edge cases are documented in
docs/components.md.
